name: openpali-usgs-3dep-postfire-aoi
description: FROZEN spatial AOI for SPATIAL-001 (committed before execution). Covers the Pacific Palisades 'Alphabet Streets' area: 1,728 destroyed-universe parcels (verified against release rel-27386c5f parcels) across exactly four independently requested USGS LOD tiles.

source.title: USGS 2025 Post-Wildfire LiDAR, Los Angeles CA (PRELIMINARY) — bare-earth DEM rasters
source.program: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP), NV5/UCSD emergency acquisition
source.rights: U.S. public domain (USGS). Provider statement: 'These datasets are provided as-is for emergency response purposes and have not been reviewed by USGS for accuracy.' Observation kind: post_fire_observation (2025-01-21 emergency baseline), never current construction evidence.
